+# Bundled zone portrait emblems
+
+This folder contains 57 unmodified `.tga` textures from upstream Spoken:
+
+- Source: [rusty-key/spoken-wow](https://github.com/rusty-key/spoken-wow/tree/59a3445d70346b69815efa8cec5f21156dc4d144/addons/Spoken/Textures/Zones)
+- Pinned upstream revision: `59a3445d70346b69815efa8cec5f21156dc4d144`
+- Upstream attribution: [THIRD_PARTY.md](https://github.com/rusty-key/spoken-wow/blob/59a3445d70346b69815efa8cec5f21156dc4d144/THIRD_PARTY.md)
+
+Most zone emblems originate from Blizzard's later-game zone-achievement artwork;
+the Azeroth globe and battleground images also derive from game assets. The
+custom Forever-zone, city and Moonglade emblems were made for upstream Spoken in
+the same visual style. The MIT license covering the addon code **does not**
+grant rights to this artwork. See the linked upstream third-party notice.
+
+The map ID -> filename table is in `SoftSpoken/API.lua`. Narrator portraits
+are chosen in `SoftSpoken_Places/Audio.lua`: subzone audio reuses its parent
+zone's icon, and a missing icon uses the existing SoftSpoken book art.
+Scenic illustrations in `SoftSpoken_Places/Textures/Pictures/` are a separate
+asset set, retained for the Places Compendium.

+-- Shared faction crest used by both the Compendium quest parchment and
+-- the Stories audio-player portrait when an NPC model cannot be shown.
+-- Keep one source of truth for the assets and for Turtle 1.12 faction lookup.
+SSCQuestFactionCrest = SSCQuestFactionCrest or {}
+local F = SSCQuestFactionCrest
+
+local ALLIANCE = "Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken_Stories\\Assets\\AllianceCrest"
+local HORDE = "Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken_Stories\\Assets\\HordeCrest"
+local UNKNOWN = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Book_11"
+local ALLIANCE_RACES = {
+    human=true, dwarf=true, gnome=true, nightelf=true,
+    highelf=true, highborne=true,
+}
+local HORDE_RACES = {
+    orc=true, undead=true, scourge=true, tauren=true,
+    troll=true, goblin=true,
+}
+
+function F.PlayerFaction()
+    if type(UnitFactionGroup) == "function" then
+        local ok, faction = pcall(UnitFactionGroup, "player")
+        if ok and (faction == "Alliance" or faction == "Horde") then return faction end
+    end
+    -- Older Turtle clients may not expose UnitFactionGroup at addon load.
+    -- The second UnitRace return is the nonlocalized race name when available.
+    if type(UnitRace) == "function" then
+        local ok, race, english = pcall(UnitRace, "player")
+        if ok then
+            local key = string.lower(string.gsub(tostring(english or race or ""), "[^%a]", ""))
+            if ALLIANCE_RACES[key] then return "Alliance" end
+            if HORDE_RACES[key] then return "Horde" end
+        end
+    end
+end
+
+-- Always return a normal full-UV texture (both crests are transparent 256x256).
+-- The second return value is the existing Compendium tooltip.
+function F.Resolve()
+    local faction = F.PlayerFaction()
+    if faction == "Alliance" then return ALLIANCE, "Alliance crest (your faction)" end
+    if faction == "Horde" then return HORDE, "Horde crest (your faction)" end
+    return UNKNOWN, "Your faction is unavailable"
+end

+-- Run from the repository root: lua5.1 tests/classicapi_portrait_compatibility.lua
+-- Run the real SoftSpoken portrait renderer against mock Vanilla/ClassicAPI
+-- frames, rather than testing a rewritten copy of its branching logic.
+
+local function expect(actual, wanted, label)
+    assert(actual == wanted, (label or "value") .. ": expected " ..
+        tostring(wanted) .. ", got " .. tostring(actual))
+end
+
+local function Scenario(version)
+    local frames, requests, current, refreshes = {}, {}, nil, 0
+    local known = {}
+    local function Frame(kind)
+        local obj = {kind=kind, calls={}, scripts={}, shown=false}
+        function obj:Call(name, value)
+            table.insert(self.calls, {name=name,value=value})
+        end
+        function obj:Hide() self.shown=false;self:Call("Hide") end
+        function obj:Show()
+            self.shown=true
+            self:Call("Show",self.display)
+        end
+        function obj:IsShown() return self.shown end
+        function obj:SetAllPoints() self:Call("SetAllPoints") end
+        function obj:ClearModel() self.display=nil;self.modelPath=nil;self:Call("ClearModel") end
+        function obj:SetScript(name,handler) self.scripts[name]=handler end
+        function obj:RegisterEvent(name) self.event=name end
+        function obj:SetCamera(value) self:Call("SetCamera",value) end
+        function obj:SetLight(...) self:Call("SetLight") end
+        function obj:GetModel()
+            if kind=="PlayerModel" and version=="new" then return nil end
+            return self.modelPath
+        end
+        if (kind=="PlayerModel" and version=="new") or
+           (kind=="Model" and version=="old") then
+            function obj:SetDisplayInfo(id)
+                self.display=id
+                self.modelPath="creature/"..tostring(id)
+                self:Call("SetDisplayInfo",id)
+            end
+        end
+        if kind=="PlayerModel" and version=="new" then
+            function obj:SetPortraitZoom(value) self:Call("SetPortraitZoom",value) end
+            function obj:RefreshCamera() self:Call("RefreshCamera") end
+        end
+        if kind=="Frame" then obj:Show() end
+        table.insert(frames,obj)
+        return obj
+    end
+    local function Create(kind)
+        return Frame(kind)
+    end
+    local speaker = {
+        GetCurrent=function() return current end,
+        RefreshPlayer=function() refreshes=refreshes+1 end,
+    }
+    local env = setmetatable({
+        Renderers={}, Version={
+            IsLegacyVanilla=true,IsRetailVanilla=false,
+            IsRetailOrAboveLegacyVersion=function() return false end,
+        },
+        Spoken=speaker, UIParent={}, CreateFrame=Create,
+        SoundQueue={IsPlaying=function() return true end,IsPaused=function() return false end},
+        C_CreatureInfo={
+            GetCreatureInfoByID=function(id)
+                return known[id] and {displayID=known[id]} or nil
+            end,
+            RequestLoadCreatureByID=function(id)
+                table.insert(requests,id)
+                return true
+            end,
+        },
+    }, {__index=_G})
+    SpokenEnv = env
+    SoftSpokenClassicPortraits = nil
+    dofile("SoftSpoken/UI/Portrait.lua")
+
+    local portrait = {shown=true}
+    function portrait:IsShown() return self.shown end
+    function portrait:CreateTexture()
+        local t={shown=false}
+        function t:SetAllPoints() end
+        function t:Show() self.shown=true end
+        function t:Hide() self.shown=false end
+        function t:SetTexture(v) self.texture=v end
+        function t:SetTexCoord() end
+        return t
+    end
+    local function Clip(id, displayID)
+        return {present={portrait={
+            kind="creature",creatureID=id,displayID=displayID,
+            fallback={kind="texture",texture="fallback.tga"},
+        }}}
+    end
+    local function Configure(clip)
+        current=clip
+        env.Portrait:Configure(portrait,clip)
+    end
+    local function GetModel()
+        return portrait.creatureModel
+    end
+    local function FindCall(model,name)
+        for i,call in ipairs(model.calls) do
+            if call.name==name then return i,call.value end
+        end
+    end
+
+    if version=="new" or version=="old" then
+        Configure(Clip(101,330))
+        local model=GetModel()
+        expect(model.kind,version=="new" and "PlayerModel" or "Model",version.." backend")
+        expect(model.display,330,version.." display ID")
+        expect(portrait.active,"creature",version.." active renderer")
+        local assigned=FindCall(model,"SetDisplayInfo")
+        local shown=FindCall(model,"Show")
+        assert(assigned and shown and assigned<shown,"assign a display before showing it")
+        if version=="new" then
+            expect(FindCall(model,"SetPortraitZoom")~=nil,true,"native portrait zoom")
+            expect(FindCall(model,"SetCamera"),nil,"no manual camera with PlayerModel")
+            expect(FindCall(model,"SetLight"),nil,"no manual light with PlayerModel")
+            expect(model:GetModel(),nil,"new model can load asynchronously")
+            expect(model.shown,true,"new renderer stays visible while loading")
+        else
+            expect(FindCall(model,"SetCamera")~=nil,true,"legacy camera")
+            expect(FindCall(model,"SetLight")~=nil,true,"legacy lighting")
+        end
+
+        -- Switch speaker on the same renderer. No previous speaker can remain
+        -- on screen while the new display is being installed.
+        model.calls={}
+        Configure(Clip(202,440))
+        expect(model.display,440,"speaker switch display")
+        expect(portrait.active,"creature","speaker switch renderer")
+        assigned=FindCall(model,"SetDisplayInfo")
+        shown=FindCall(model,"Show")
+        local hidden=FindCall(model,"Hide")
+        assert(hidden and assigned and shown and hidden<assigned and assigned<shown,
+            "hide stale model, assign new display, then show")
+
+        -- A missing display must fall back to texture and release the model.
+        Configure(Clip(303))
+        expect(portrait.active,"texture","uncached creature fallback")
+        expect(model.shown,false,"hide model while waiting for cache")
+        expect(model._spokenDisplayID,nil,"forget stale display ID")
+        expect(requests[1],303,"request uncached creature")
+
+        -- The same clip becomes renderable when ClassicAPI's cache updates.
+        known[303]=555
+        Configure(Clip(303))
+        expect(portrait.active,"creature","loaded creature becomes visible")
+        expect(model.display,555,"loaded creature appearance")
+        SoftSpokenClassicPortraits = false
+        Configure(Clip(303,555))
+        expect(portrait.active,"texture","disabled optional API uses fallback")
+        SoftSpokenClassicPortraits = nil
+    else
+        Configure(Clip(101,330))
+        expect(portrait.active,"texture","no model API texture fallback")
+        expect(portrait.creatureModel,nil,"no unsupported model selected")
+    end
+
+    -- Simulate two asynchronous responses before one OnUpdate. Both IDs must
+    -- be retained, not overwritten by the last event. Only the current NPC
+    -- should cause a player repaint; the queue itself is never advanced.
+    if version~="none" then
+        Configure(Clip(701))
+        Configure(Clip(702))
+        local eventFrame
+        for _,f in ipairs(frames) do
+            if f.kind=="Frame" and f.event=="CREATURE_DATA_LOAD_RESULT" then
+                eventFrame=f
+            end
+        end
+        assert(eventFrame,"registered ClassicAPI cache event")
+        eventFrame.scripts.OnEvent(eventFrame,"CREATURE_DATA_LOAD_RESULT",701,true)
+        eventFrame.scripts.OnEvent(eventFrame,"CREATURE_DATA_LOAD_RESULT",702,true)
+        current=Clip(701)
+        eventFrame.scripts.OnUpdate(eventFrame,0)
+        expect(refreshes,1,"both responses retained until refresh")
+        expect(eventFrame.scripts.OnUpdate,nil,"remove completed update handler")
+        -- If the current clip is unrelated, responses must not refresh it.
+        eventFrame.scripts.OnEvent(eventFrame,"CREATURE_DATA_LOAD_RESULT",702,true)
+        current=Clip(900)
+        eventFrame.scripts.OnUpdate(eventFrame,0)
+        expect(refreshes,1,"do not refresh wrong speaker")
+    end
+    return true
+end
+
+Scenario("old")
+Scenario("new")
+Scenario("none")
+print("PASS: legacy and current ClassicAPI portrait backends, fallback and cache events")

+-- Run at repo root: lua5.1 tests/places_zone_portrait_emblems.lua
+-- Verify actual upstream zone badges, asset coverage, and Spaces narrator
+-- portraits without launching the WoW client.
+
+local function expect(actual,wanted,label)
+    assert(actual==wanted,(label or "value")..": expected "..tostring(wanted)..
+        ", got "..tostring(actual))
+end
+
+Spoken={}
+C_Map={GetMapInfo=function(id)
+    if id==9999 then return {parentMapID=1457} end
+end}
+
+-- Execute the actual ZoneIcon implementation from API.lua. Its surrounding
+-- public APIs require an initialized WoW client; isolate only this real block.
+local f=assert(io.open("SoftSpoken/API.lua","r"))
+local api=f:read("*a")
+f:close()
+local section=api:match("%-%- Zone icons by uiMapID(.-)%-%- C_Container")
+local block=section and ("-- Zone icons by uiMapID" .. section)
+assert(block,"ZoneIcon API section was not found")
+local load=assert(loadstring(block))
+load()
+
+local root="Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken\\Textures\\Zones\\"
+local function icon(id,filename)
+    local texture,crop=Spoken:ZoneIcon(id)
+    expect(texture,root..filename,"zone emblem "..tostring(id))
+    expect(crop[1],filename=="Azeroth" and 0 or 0.08,"left crop "..id)
+    expect(crop[2],filename=="Azeroth" and 1 or 0.92,"right crop "..id)
+end
+icon(1411,"Durotar")
+icon(1438,"Teldrassil")
+icon(1457,"Darnassus")
+icon(1453,"Stormwind")
+icon(1454,"Orgrimmar")
+icon(1455,"Ironforge")
+icon(1456,"ThunderBluff")
+icon(1458,"Undercity")
+icon(1450,"Moonglade")
+icon(1459,"AlteracValley")
+icon(1460,"WarsongGulch")
+icon(1461,"ArathiBasin")
+icon(947,"Azeroth")
+icon(9999,"Darnassus") -- map not in icon table inherits its parent's icon
+expect(Spoken:ZoneIcon(88888),nil,"unknown map without ancestor")
+
+-- All map entries must reference artwork actually bundled with SoftSpoken.
+local unique, count={},0
+for id,filename in pairs(Spoken.ZONE_ICONS) do
+    local path="SoftSpoken/Textures/Zones/"..filename..".tga"
+    local handle=io.open(path,"rb")
+    assert(handle,"missing zone emblem for map "..id..": "..path)
+    handle:close()
+    if not unique[filename] then unique[filename]=true;count=count+1 end
+end
+expect(count,57,"all upstream icon assets mapped")
+
+local registryPack={
+    version=1,addon="SpokenPlacesAudio",
+    zones={
+        [1411]={file="1411/zone",len=10},
+        [1457]={file="1457/zone",len=10},
+        [947]={file="947/zone",len=10},
+        [88888]={file="88888/zone",len=10},
+    },
+    subzones={[1411]={["valley of trials"]={file="1411/valley",len=8}}},
+}
+SpokenPlacesAudioPacks={SpokenPlacesAudio=registryPack}
+SSZZonesRuntime={
+    Normalise=function(text) return string.lower(text or "") end,
+    AudioID=function() return 1411 end,
+    HeardKey=function(id,area) return "z:"..tostring(id)..":"..tostring(area or "") end,
+    WasHeard=function() return false end,
+    CharDB=function() return {heard={}} end,
+    Say=function() end,
+}
+dofile("SoftSpoken_Places/Audio.lua")
+local r=SSZZonesRuntime
+local durotar=r.MakeClip(1411,"Durotar","Durotar",true,false)
+local valley=r.MakeClip(1411,"Durotar","Valley of Trials",false,false)
+local city=r.MakeClip(1457,"Darnassus","Darnassus",true,false)
+expect(durotar.present.portrait.texture,root.."Durotar","zone narrator badge")
+expect(valley.present.portrait.texture,root.."Durotar","subzone inherits zone badge")
+expect(city.present.portrait.texture,root.."Darnassus","city-specific narrator badge")
+expect(durotar.present.portrait.texCoord[1],0.08,"beveled zone icon crop")
+expect(durotar.present.portrait.fit,nil,"no landscape cover crop")
+
+local mystery=r.MakeClip(88888,"Unknown","Unknown",true,false)
+expect(mystery.present.portrait.texture,
+    "Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken\\Textures\\Book","unmapped zone book fallback")
+
+-- Compendium images stay intact. The narrator does not reuse those scenic
+-- pictures as round portraits (which was an accidental deviation from upstream).
+SSZPictures={
+    [1411]={[""]="1411-zone",["valley of trials"]="1411-valley"},
+}
+dofile("SoftSpoken_Places/UI/Pictures.lua")
+local picture=SSZPicturesUI.Get(1411,"valley of trials")
+expect(picture,
+    "Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken_Places\\Textures\\Pictures\\1411-valley",
+    "separate Compendium landscape source")
+assert(picture~=valley.present.portrait.texture,
+    "scene art must not replace narrator zone emblem")
+
+-- No crashes or non-zone overlays if an alternate player lacks ZoneIcon.
+Spoken.ZoneIcon=nil
+local without=r.MakeClip(1411,"Durotar","Durotar",true,false)
+expect(without.present.portrait.texture,
+    "Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken\\Textures\\Book",
+    "legacy player without ZoneIcon fallback")
+
+print("PASS: zone, subzone, city and battleground emblems, 57 assets, Compendium art")

+-- Real faction resolver and real Stories Player:Prepare portrait specification.
+
+local function expect(actual,wanted,label)

+
+dofile("SoftSpoken_Stories/FactionCrest.lua")
+local F=SSCQuestFactionCrest
+local ALLIANCE="Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken_Stories\\Assets\\AllianceCrest"
+local HORDE="Interface\\AddOns\\SoftSpoken_Stories\\Assets\\HordeCrest"
+local UNKNOWN="Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Book_11"
+
+UnitFactionGroup=function() return "Alliance" end
+UnitRace=function() return "Orc","Orc" end
+local texture,label=F.Resolve()
+expect(texture,ALLIANCE,"faction API takes precedence")
+expect(label,"Alliance crest (your faction)","Alliance tooltip")
+
+UnitFactionGroup=function() return "Horde" end
+texture,label=F.Resolve()
+expect(texture,HORDE,"Horde faction")
+expect(label,"Horde crest (your faction)","Horde tooltip")
+
+UnitFactionGroup=nil
+UnitRace=function() return "Elfo de la noche","Night Elf" end
+expect(F.Resolve(),ALLIANCE,"English race fallback, Night Elf")
+UnitRace=function() return "High Elf","High Elf" end
+expect(F.Resolve(),ALLIANCE,"High Elf faction")
+UnitRace=function() return "Undead","Scourge" end
+expect(F.Resolve(),HORDE,"Scourge faction")
+UnitRace=function() return "Goblin","Goblin" end
+expect(F.Resolve(),HORDE,"Goblin faction")
+
+UnitFactionGroup=function() error("unsupported in client") end
+UnitRace=function() return "Tauren","Tauren" end
+expect(F.Resolve(),HORDE,"API error falls back to race")
+
+UnitFactionGroup=nil
+UnitRace=function() return "Unknown","Unknown" end
+texture,label=F.Resolve()
+expect(texture,UNKNOWN,"unavailable faction matches Compendium")
+expect(label,"Your faction is unavailable","unknown faction tooltip")
+
+-- The player prepares a real clip and requests precisely this crest as its
+-- texture fallback. Renderers consume the spec without constructing assets.
+UnitFactionGroup=function() return "Alliance" end
+VoiceOver=setmetatable({
+    AddonFolder="SoftSpoken_Stories",
+    format=string.format, -- supplied by the addon environment in-game
+    L={},
+    Enums={
+        SoundEvent={
+            QuestAccept=1,QuestProgress=2,QuestComplete=3,
+            QuestGreeting=4,Gossip=5,QuestFollowup=6,
+            IsGossipEvent=function(self,event) return event==4 or event==5 end,
+            IsQuestEvent=function(self,event) return event==1 or event==2 or event==3 end,
+        },
+        GUID={IsCreature=function(self,kind) return kind=="Creature" end},
+    },
+    DataModules={
+        GetQuestLogQuestGiverTypeAndID=function(self,id)
+            if id==123 then return "Creature",448 end
+        end,
+    },

+expect(quest.fallback.texCoord[2],1,"crest uncropped right")
